# Shared QFT source context

Informed development after shared Xor/GHZ source implementation, following the
user instruction to implement the corpus before more general proof work. The
pinned Qualtran QFT source, finite qft2/qft3, shared-gradient hierarchical
producer and independently bound Fourier host checker were already known.
No controlled model evaluation or new upstream download was performed. This
actual source was saved before its first experimental compiler check. The
initial body uses explicit nested folds and swaps; static comparisons and
controlled dyadic phases expose the next concrete language gaps.
